name: Leadership Award (miniature medal body)
size_basis: estimated: the body measured in the Vanguard product photograph against the suspension ribbon's width, 181 px taken as 0.6875 in (the miniature suspension ribbon, 11/16 in, CAPR 39-1 11.3 as compose.js MINI_DRAPE): body 0.6875 x 0.6837 in in the photograph. Height follows the body's own aspect. The width is the existing CAP asset's (0.625 in, assets/medals, kept as the brief asks; the photo measures 0.6875 in). The drawing keeps the width and the box; it is built from the photograph's own measured proportions (body scale 292 px per in, body width 0.625 in).
ribbon_attach_note: ribbon_attach is the bail axis at the box top (the box cuts the ring away) (upright body, hang angle -2.24 deg removed); compose.js hangs it at the drape's V point

dimensions.ribbon_note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices (ribbon_ref as the previous asset)

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is the top of the suspension ring.

frame.note: body width 0.625 in (the spec width) sets the scale; every length below is inches in the medal frame (origin = disc centre, +y down, UPRIGHT: the photograph is rotated by the measured hang angle into this frame)

measured.hang_angle_note: measured from the bail axis against the disc centre in the photograph (frame.js); the drawing hangs upright (bail and disc axis vertical)
not_measurable: the engraving grain (dark pits, crystalline texture) of the ground and the wing face: flat tones are drawn

the exact curve of the wing's edges between the read points (smooth curves through 4 upper and 6 lower points per half are drawn); the wing is assumed symmetric about u 0.0005 (read on the left half, mirrored)
the propeller blades are lens shapes of equal width: the photograph shows them slightly teardrop (wider near the hub)
bar ends: the bars stop 0.014 in inside the inner circle line at the top and bottom (read at three bars); the 13-bar count and 0.0285 pitch are measured, the 0.0075 width is a threshold-blurred width
the inner circle is slightly wider than tall in the photograph (r 0.210 horizontal, 0.205 vertical by eye): drawn as a circle with the ridge-fit r 0.2037

palette.ramp: silver studio ramp (lib.js SILVER_RAMP), tones picked from the reference luminance classes

gates.silhouette_iou: >= 0.95 (shipped upright miniature vs the photograph body mask rotated into the upright frame)
gates.landmarks: every named feature centroid within 0.02 in of the reference
gates.edge_recall: lit-metal outline recall >= 0.80 within 0.012 in (0.006 in reported)
gates.ribbon_attach: top centre of the ring (bail axis at the box top where the box cuts the ring)

ribbon_attach_units.basis: bail axis at the box top (the box cuts the ring away)

fidelity.note: Redrawn as clean parametric vector (LIVE13-ART 25/26): every object (disc, rim, lettering, emblem parts, bail, ring) is modelled as what it is, from measured parameters, not traced; flat tones with a lit and a shadow edge. Replaces the traced body (LIVE13-ART 20).

fit_score.note: IoU of the shipped upright miniature against the photograph body mask rotated into the upright frame (design/kitA.js)

notes: Designed miniature medal body (LIVE13-ART 26). Measured from leadership-award.jpeg (reference only, never shipped). Silver miniature (plain silver).
